decision_summary: Proceed with QIF v0.3 Discovery Layer design as a separate pre-QIF discovery mechanism.
rationale: The validated need, gate packet, and three-role review agree that the next version should design failure-oriented Discovery Patterns while preserving QIF as representation and blocking checklist regression.
recommendation: Draft docs/qif-v0.3-discovery-layer-design.md and defer schema/runtime implementation to a follow-up task.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and AI coding agents
expected_user_reaction: Use the design as the next-version planning basis before implementation.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add a design document only; update README/changelog later when implementation scope is accepted.
organization_change_recommendations: Treat Discovery Layer governance as candidate-intent review, not semantic truth approval.
